data.turoyo: <...> W adyawma u abro du malko yo w u malko w i aṯto məxtalaffe aʕle.
data.translation: Heute ist er der Sohn des Königs, über den sich der König und seine Frau entzweit haben;

rationale: Thin Preterit cell; overt coordinated participants and pronominal ʕal-topic.

summary: The disagreement issue is coded by ʕal in both a full NP and aʕle. Coordinated king-and-wife participants express reciprocal disagreement without separate Detransitive morphology.
Arabic VIII-derived məxtalaf- belongs to the glossary’s active I; initial mə- and reciprocal meaning do not license a new Detransitive box. No new sense or idiomatic phrase is established.
